## Load the cleaned data
```{r}
load("12_DataSaving.RData")
```


Percents of COVID and Pneumonia deaths to all deaths, and the percent of Pneumonia deaths in Pneumonia and COVID deaths.
```{r}
covid_cleaned$covid_pct_of_all <- percent_of(covid_cleaned$COVID.19.Deaths,
                                             covid_cleaned$Total.Deaths)
covid_cleaned$pneu_pct_of_all <- percent_of(covid_cleaned$Pneumonia.Deaths,
                                            covid_cleaned$Total.Deaths)
covid_cleaned$pneu_pct_of_covid <- percent_of(
                                   covid_cleaned$Pneumonia.and.COVID.19.Deaths, 
                                   covid_cleaned$COVID.19.Deaths)
covid_cleaned
```

Adding age bands so we can use numerics ages in future graphs.
```{r}
n_obs <- nrow(covid_cleaned)
covid_cleaned$age_mid <- rep(0, n_obs)
for (obs_ind in 1:n_obs) {
  covid_cleaned$age_mid[obs_ind] <- get_age_mid(covid_cleaned$Age.Group[obs_ind])
}

covid_cleaned
```

Converting the age groups to factor so they're ordered properly so future plots/graphs don't misorder them.

```{r}
covid_cleaned$Age.Group <- factor(covid_cleaned$Age.Group,
  levels = c("Under 1 year", "1-4 years", "5-14 years", "15-24 years",
             "25-34 years", "35-44 years", "45-54 years", "55-64 years",
             "65-74 years", "75-84 years", "85 years and over"),
  ordered = TRUE)
covid_cleaned
```
